items.mainDefect: The async legacy-write goroutines derive their context from the request context, so they are canceled when the handler returns and the legacy writes commonly fail.

secondary.defect: Legacy write errors inside the goroutines are never logged, only recorded as metrics, so legacy storage can drift out of sync without anyone noticing.

items.mainDefect: The fire-and-forget legacy-write goroutines use the request context, which is canceled when the handler returns, so the legacy writes nearly always fail.

secondary.defect: Legacy write errors are not logged, so nothing reports them now that the write is async.

items.mainDefect: The legacy-write goroutines wrap the HTTP request context, which is canceled right after the handler returns, so the legacy writes are aborted and the 10s timeout never takes effect.

secondary.defect: Legacy write failures are only recorded to metrics and never logged, so the stores diverge with no signal.

items.mainDefect: Update passes the raw objInfo to the async Legacy.Update instead of an updateWrapper holding the unified-store result, so legacy can save a different object than unified storage.

secondary.defect: The caller's UpdatedObjectInfo is invoked a second time after Storage.Update has already used it, which may not be safe or idempotent.

items.mainDefect: Update no longer pins the legacy write to the unified-storage result through updateWrapper, so legacy recomputes the object and the stores can diverge.

secondary.defect: UpdatedObject now runs twice, which breaks UpdatedObjectInfo implementations that are not idempotent.

items.mainDefect: Update hands the raw objInfo to the legacy store, which recomputes the object against its own old state, so legacy and unified storage can persist different objects.

secondary.defect: Because the async legacy writes have no ordering, concurrent updates to the same object can reach legacy in a different order than storage, leaving legacy permanently stale.

items.mainDefect: When Storage.Create fails, the error path records the legacy duration metric instead of the storage duration metric.

secondary.defect: When Storage.Update fails, the error path at line 129 also records the legacy duration metric instead of the storage duration metric.

items.mainDefect: When Storage.Create fails, the error path records the legacy duration metric instead of the storage duration metric.

secondary.defect: When Storage.Update fails, the error path also records the legacy duration metric, so storage errors pollute the legacy metric.

items.mainDefect: The Delete success path passes the object name instead of options.Kind as the kind label of the storage duration metric.

secondary.defect: Delete puts the bare d.Log into the context instead of the enriched log, dropping the name, kind and method fields.
